column2: ⌨️cli is the cli domain of the semio repository tooling: the root command, its configuration and the process entry points.
📡️engine carries the cli engine: the event stream protocol, the error codes, the engine requests and the engine dispatch.
📤️export carries the event-log export of the cli and the export command.
🔐️auth_sync carries the auth and sync commands of the cli.
🔎️search carries the entity emoji, search, list and query commands of the cli with their tree filter flags.
🧪️test_command carries the test command of the cli with its llm, effort and client flag extraction.
📝️todo carries the draft and todo commands of the cli.
🎫️ticket carries the ticket command of the cli.
🎯️goal carries the goal command of the cli.
💬️interaction carries the interaction and checkpoint commands of the cli.
📜️statute carries the statute command of the cli.
🧑️contributor carries the contributor and technology commands of the cli.
🌊️stream carries the stream and status flag binding of the cli and the stream options.
🗂️codebase carries the bundle, folder, file, section, definition and mermaid commands of the cli.
🚚️move carries the move, integrate, extract and rename commands of the cli.
📏️loc carries the loc command of the cli.
🎟️tool_ticket carries the ticket and draft tool functions of the cli.
🏹️tool_goal carries the goal and contributor tool functions of the cli.
🧱️tool_codebase carries the codebase, technology, bundle, folder, file, section and definition tool functions of the cli.
🩺️analyze carries the analyze and autofix commands of the cli with the policy tool functions.
🏁️benchmark carries the benchmark command of the cli.
🪝️hook carries the hook, configure and micro-commit commands of the cli.
🔄️update carries the dependency update command of the cli.
🚩️flag carries the flag set of the cli command framework.
🕹️command carries the command tree, dispatch and positional validators of the cli command framework.
🪞️projection carries the projection commands, argument projection and event stream rendering of the cli.
🌳️tree carries the filesystem tree source and the tree command of the cli.
